documents.title: Approved Cedar Systems product information
documents.text: Cedar Systems provides workflow coordination and account reporting. A discovery meeting can establish integration requirements. No price, deployment timeline, uptime guarantee or specific vendor connector is approved here.

documents.title: Customer inquiry and call evidence
documents.text: An earlier inquiry from our manufacturing team requested discovery about duplicate follow-ups. The latest call says the project is paused and the owner disagrees about the requirement. Please clarify the contradictory project information before proposing a meeting.

raw_proposal.assessment: The account is currently in the 'qualified' stage with a score of 80. The customer has provided consent, and the owner is cedar-east. There is a customer inquiry indicating a need for clarification on project status and requirements before proceeding with a discovery meeting.

claims.quote: Please clarify the contradictory project information before proposing a meeting.

raw_proposal.draft:
Dear [Customer Name],

Thank you for your inquiry. We understand that there are some conflicting details regarding the project status and requirements. To ensure we align properly and provide the best support, could you please clarify the current project status and any specific requirements you have in mind?

We are here to assist and look forward to your response.

Best regards,
[Your Name]
[Your Position]
Cedar Systems
questions: What is the current status of the project?
Are there any specific requirements or concerns you would like to address during the discovery meeting?
uncertainties: The project status is unclear and needs clarification.
There is a potential conflict between the manufacturing team's inquiry and the latest call details.
